([[Bradenton, Florida]]) | college = [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor]] (2022–present) | highlights = * [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] Freshman of the Year (2023) * Big 12 All-Newcomer Team (2023) * Big 12 All-Freshman Team (2023) * Second-team All-Big 12 (2023) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2022]]) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2022) * [[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2022) * [[FIBA 3x3 Under-18 World Cup]] MVP (2021) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's [[3x3 basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|the {{3x3|USA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA 3x3 Under-18 World Cup|FIBA Under-18 World Cup]]|[[United States men's national 3x3 team|Team]]}} {{MedalGold|2021 Hungary|[[United States men's national 3x3 team|Team]]}} }} '''Keyonte Darnell George''' (born November 8, 2003) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]] of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class. ==High school career== George began playing high school basketball for [[Lewisville High School]] in [[Lewisville, Texas]].{{cite web |last1=Bossi |first1=Eric |title=Class of 2022 Keyonte George has KU, Texas, others on radar |url=https://basketballrecruiting.rivals.com/news/class-of-2022-keyonte-george-has-ku-texas-others-on-radar |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=September 17, 2021 |date=December 6, 2019}} As a freshman, he averaged 21 points, four rebounds and 1.9 steals per game, and was named District 6-6A Offensive Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Thomas |first1=Justin |title=The best on the basketball court: Locals named to 6-6A all-district team |url=https://starlocalmedia.com/carrolltonleader/sports/the-best-on-the-basketball-court-locals-named-to-6-6a-all-district-team/article_0624213e-45b4-11e9-bb91-7395a468ab24.html |website=Carrollton Leader |access-date=September 17, 2021 |date=March 13, 2019}} George averaged 23.9 points, 5.1 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 2.1 steals per game as a sophomore, earning District 6-6A MVP honors. For his junior season, he transferred to iSchool of Lewisville.{{cite web |last1=Riddle |first1=Greg |title=Five-star basketball recruit Keyonte George is transferring from Lewisville to iSchool of Lewisville |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2020/05/01/five-star-basketball-recruit-keyonte-george-is-transferring-from-lewisville-to-ischool-of-lewisville/ |website=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |access-date=September 17, 2021 |date=May 1, 2020}} George averaged 24.8 points per game as a junior.{{cite web |last1=Biancardi |first1=Paul |authorlink1=Paul Biancardi |last2=Borzello |first2=Jeff |title=Top-five 2022 prospect Keyonte George commits to Baylor Bears |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31988003 |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=September 17, 2021 |date=August 8, 2021}} He moved to [[IMG Academy]] in [[Bradenton, Florida]] for his senior season.{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=High school basketball: Keyonte George, Dior Johnson and Mikey Williams among impact transfers |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/2ctu0sgTGEybI-F803qWNw/high-school-basketball--keyonte-george,-dior-johnson-and-mikey-williams-among-impact-transfers.htm |website=[[MaxPreps]] |access-date=September 17, 2021 |date=September 2, 2021}} ===Recruiting=== George was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class, according to major recruiting services. On August 8, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor]] over offers from [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]], [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech]], [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] and [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]]. {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2022}} {{College
